verdict.rationale: The evidence shows n8n has a documented public API (an 'n8n API' docs page), so programmatic workflow management by an agent is plausible. The pack only gives the page title, though, and never shows workflow create, update or activate operations. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 at the docs-site paths, which leaves the API surface unverified but does not contradict it. Missing for 10: documented create/update/activate workflow endpoints, an API auth/key mechanism, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on or independent evidence of an agent driving workflow lifecycle via the API.
